summary: A 1931 10-foot L-4 pole tower on Cooks Mountain near Usk; removed or destroyed on an unknown date, with footings reported on the summit.

facts.design: 10-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: The tower is gone. Sources say removed or destroyed, with no date; Willhite reports footings on the summit in an undated visit.

access.note: On Forest Service land; Willhite reports no gate on the north approach from road NF-5015, and the road is in fair shape to the saddle north of the peak.

visit.trail_note: Park at the saddle north of the peak and hike up the north ridge; Willhite lists 0.4 miles and 650 feet of gain. Willhite reports only footings on the summit, so there is nothing to climb.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1931 build date agrees across all four pages. The end of the tower is undated; the register says removed, FireLookout.com and Willhite say destroyed, and the lookout history site lists it as removed. No staffing or fire history appears in any page read, so no staffing facts are recorded. Access as public is an inference from Forest Service land and an unobstructed road and hike described by Willhite, not a stated status. Willhite's photo captions on the page are undated, so the footings sighting has no date.
